work.math: $10 a month. 100 GB of data sent out is within the included 3 TB. Tax, an outside CI service (automatic builds and tests) and the domain are not included.
The 730 hourly charges in a month go over the 672-hour monthly cap, so the charge stays at $10 a month before tax. Optional backup is not in this price.
$20 a month for the server, plus optional daily backup at 20% ($4). Backup retention and tax are not included.
